roster_rules.verified_specification: Club Active/Inactive List is capped at 53 players in regular season and playoffs, expandable to 54 or 55 players solely via Practice Squad Standard Elevations.
roster_rules.lineup_deficiency_relevance: Caps how many healthy backups a club can carry when multiple starters are Questionable without placing players on multi-week IR.

roster_rules.verified_specification: Maximum game-day Active List is 48 players ONLY if the club dresses >=8 offensive linemen (primary position C, G, or OT); otherwise the cap drops to 47 players.
roster_rules.lineup_deficiency_relevance: Forces clubs to dress 2nd/3rd-string swing offensive linemen on game day, directly shaping trench backup availability.

roster_rules.verified_specification: 16 players standard in 2026, expandable to 17 players if one qualifies via the International Player Pathway (IPP) Program.
roster_rules.lineup_deficiency_relevance: Primary reservoir of 3rd- and 4th-string emergency replacements when starters and primary backups are Out.

roster_rules.rule_name: 90-Minute Pregame Inactive List & C2P Helmet Cutoff
roster_rules.verified_specification: Exactly 90 minutes before scheduled kickoff, club PR delivers the Game Day Administration Report (official Inactive List + primary/backup C2P helmet players + roof status) to the Referee.
roster_rules.lineup_deficiency_relevance: Hard pre-kickoff timestamp when Questionable/Doubtful ambiguity resolves into confirmed starter vs. 2nd/3rd/4th-string active status.

roster_rules.verified_specification: Practice: DNP, Limited (<100% normal reps), Full (100% normal reps). Game Status: Out (will not play), Doubtful (unlikely), Questionable (uncertain); Probable eliminated; players certain to play carry blank Game Status.
roster_rules.lineup_deficiency_relevance: Explains why Full Participation starters carry blank Game Status on game-week reports while mid-week Sunday statuses remain blank until Friday.

roster_rules.rule_name: AT Booth Spotters & Mandatory Concussion Evaluation
roster_rules.verified_specification: Two league-assigned certified AT spotters monitor broadcast feeds and alert club medical/UNC staff; removed players must sit at least one play (unless timeout/period/2-min warning/foul).
roster_rules.lineup_deficiency_relevance: Drives sudden in-game backup snaps for 2nd/3rd-string QBs, OL, and DBs during live concussion checks.

deficiency_engine_schema.inputs: Club 53-man active roster + Reserve/Injured list + Practice Squad elevations.
deficiency_engine_schema.output_signal: Removes multi-week IR starters (like Lamar Jackson in Wk 10) who disappear from weekly practice injury tables.

deficiency_engine_schema.inputs: Official club /team/depth-chart Offense & Defense tables, handling co-starters (e.g., SEA Kupp/Shaheed) and cross-slot players (e.g., NE Ben Brown at 1st LG & 2nd C).
deficiency_engine_schema.output_signal: Directed acyclic replacement graph mapping every position slot to 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and 4th string player IDs.

deficiency_engine_schema.inputs: Wednesday/Thursday/Friday nfl.com/injuries/ DNP/LP/FP and Out/Doubtful/Questionable designations.
deficiency_engine_schema.output_signal: Probabilistic active-snap weights pre-Friday; deterministic Out exclusion once ruled Out.

deficiency_engine_schema.inputs: Official 90-minute pre-kickoff Inactive List & C2P helmet designations.
deficiency_engine_schema.output_signal: Confirms exact dressed 48-man (or 47-man) lineup and promotes active 2nd/3rd/4th-string backups.

deficiency_engine_schema.inputs: Active string-tier vector on Offense (QB, 5 OL, WR/TE/RB) vs. opposing Defense (EDGE/DL, LB, CB1–CB4, S).
deficiency_engine_schema.output_signal: Generates trench pressure alerts (>=2 backup OL vs. starter EDGE) and coverage mismatch alerts (WR1 vs. 2nd/3rd/4th-string CB).
